name: Teakettler
description: A small, behaviorally defined fearsome critter of North American lumberjack folklore that produces a teakettle-like whistling sound. First catalogued in William T. Cox's 1910 'Fearsome Creatures of the Lumberwoods'.
origin: Folklore current in the lumber-camp belt of the northern United States and Canada in the late 19th and early 20th century.
